facts.fact: 早上杂技课她练无支撑头倒立，拉伤了脖子，也做不来侧手翻。
facts.anchor: In acrobatics that morning Elise pulls a muscle in her neck trying to do an unsupported headstand

facts.fact: Tomas 宣布当天做「bouffon」练习：二十分钟上街找材料，把「人设」做得 grotesque、夸张。
facts.anchor: Today we are doing the bouffon

facts.fact: 她和 Nafkoté 去 Château d’Eau 发廊后的垃圾桶，捡 kente 碎布、假发、人造棉塞进衣服做身体。
facts.anchor: We might find wigs or something.

facts.fact: 她想起 bouffon 原是中世纪被放逐的畸形者、病人、异端，每年被押回城里游街，当众当道德教材。
facts.anchor: The bouffon—Elise is remembering now—was the name given to people exiled from the kingdom

facts.fact: 课后她买了手机，又走进运河边的发廊，把长发剪成 pixie 并漂白。
facts.anchor: She wants to feel different. No, it’s more than that.

facts.fact: 晚餐时她告诉母亲自己现在叫 Elise；Catherine 说「他走了你就彻底把 Beth 丢掉」。
facts.anchor: I actually go by Elise now.

facts.fact: 赴晚餐途中 Catherine 看见 09/09/09 的画廊海报，认出是 Luke 的画，几乎崩溃。
结尾 Elise 问起 Rossi；Catherine 说「不算熟」，末句点明她一直只是他的模特。
facts.anchor: He is a painter, and she was only ever a subject.
